# L4.6 — Live E2E capstone: the reference task live through `hh` over bindings (a)(b)(c) × {local, Anthropic, OpenAI}, sandboxed exec, calibrated judges, verify+replay, hh-web, MCP, fleet webhook, bundle reproduce

Ticket: `docs/tickets/164u_L4.6__live-e2e-capstone.md` · seq 164u · base `svitali/harnessharness-l4.5` · stacked on the L4.5 PR.

**Requirement ids:** `R-2.11.1`, `R-2.11.2`, `R-2.11.3` (the shipped `hh`/`hh-web`/`hh-mcp` surfaces driven live) · `R-2.12.6` (fleet webhook → reconciler on the sandbox) · `R-2.7.2b` (judge scoring, live evidence) · `BL-31` (live provider transports) · the round-4 charter "deep end to end live verification".

## ⚠ Surfaced blocker — deterministic replay of an effect-dispatching live run

**3/3 reproductions on the Anthropic lane:** when the live run's model
proposed a tool call (the record carries `action.tool.proposed` +
`action.effect.*` + `security.permission.decided` + the
`verification.claim/completion` chain), `replay{driver_mode:
deterministic}` answers `invalid{replay_diverged}` — the model port's
call-id match reports e.g. `model_call mc-27` (record) vs `mc-23`
(re-drive), a ~4-id skew on the shared `mc/d/e/ef` allocator caused by
the live-path permission/authorize/prepare ceremony the `ReplayGate`
serves from the record without re-minting. Runs without a dispatch
replay **byte-identically** on every lane (local ×3 bindings, OpenAI
×3, Anthropic in-process, the ledger-replay leg, the RecordedJudge
fold, bundle reproduce at R0).

Per the ticket's out-of-scope rule ("fixing a defect beyond a small,
test-backed fix — surface it for an insert") and the round-4
zero-deferral rule, this is surfaced for an operator ruling — whether
the re-drive must re-emit the ceremony or the port should match calls
positionally is a kernel-contract question. `capstone-run-anthropic`'s
record is the honest `fail` carrying the typed verdict; the AC "replay
of each live run is byte-identical offline" is **not met on evidence**.

`scripts/live-capstone.sh` orchestrates ten independently re-runnable
legs through `scripts/live-verify.sh` (the only path a live leg may
take, ADR-0363). Each leg writes a committed `hh-live-evidence/1`
record + `SPEND.jsonl` debit; secrets ride by NAME only
(`provided: yes/no`, launch_env coordinates in the ledger, leak sweep
on payloads/blobs).

## What changed

- `scripts/live-verify.sh` — ten `capstone-*` legs registered (ticket
  L4.6, secret-name sets, gated cells, endpoint hosts) + the leg
  runners (provider runs, helper cells, judge reuse, web/ledger/bundle
  cargo cells, the MCP official-SDK arm with in-repo fallback, the
  fleet leg reusing `live-github.sh`).
- `scripts/live-capstone.sh` — the orchestrator: `--list`, `--only
  a,b`, per-leg declared budgets, rc→outcome summary (never silent).
- `scripts/live-capstone-mcp.mjs` — the official-SDK MCP driver
  (runtime-installed, never a repo dep).
- `crates/hh-embed/tests/l4_6_live.rs` — four gated cells: the
  reference task × bindings matrix (`HH_CAPSTONE_PROVIDER` selects the
  lane), ledger verify+replay, `hh-web`, bundle reproduce.
- `crates/hh-mcp/tests/l4_6_live.rs` — the MCP client cell +
  `HH_MCP_BUNDLE_OUT` materialization seam.
- `crates/hh-embed/Cargo.toml` — dev-dep on
  `hharness-embed-client-generated` (the NetClient arm).
- `docs/build/reports/live/` — ten evidence records + transcripts +
  SPEND rows; `docs/build/reports/2026-10-23-live-e2e-capstone.md`;
  OPERATIONAL_READINESS rows flipped only where records prove it.
- `docs/build/runs/L4.6.md` — the run ledger (legs, finding, gap table,
  evidence log).

## AC layers

- `live-executed` — the nine passing legs (each cites its committed
  `hh-live-evidence/1` record); the anthropic leg executed live but its
  run's replay diverged — recorded `fail`, surfaced, never claimed.
- `deterministic` — replay verdicts are the system's own typed
  verdicts, reported verbatim (byte-identical where the run carried no
  effect dispatch).
- `agentic` — the capstone report, readiness amendments, run ledger,
  PR/LEDGER/index records, this body.
- `engineered` — the new gated cells ignore cleanly under plain
  `cargo test` (ADR-0363 D7 gating); no production mutation outside
  `SteveVitali/hh-live-sandbox`.
